Precipitation Datasets Analysis

Load Library:


library(package = "dplyr")
library(package = "plm")
library(package = "stringi")
library(package = "ggplot2")

Load Precipitation Data:


Precip <- read.csv(file = "result/Precip_Data_Monthly.csv", header = TRUE)

Precip <- Precip %>%
  filter(Year >= 1380 & Year <= 1394) %>%
  filter(!(Year == 1394 & Month >= 07))

Precip <- Precip %>%

Precip
NA

Create Water Year Precipitation


Precip <- Precip %>%
  mutate(Water_Year = if_else(
    condition = Month >= 7,
    true = paste(substr(x = as.character(x = Year),
                        stop = 4),
                 substr(x = as.character(x = Year + 1),
                        start = 3,
                        stop = 4),
                 sep = "-"),
    false = paste(substr(x = as.character(x = Year - 1),
                        start = 3,
                        stop = 4),
                 substr(x = as.character(x = Year),
                        start = 3,
                        stop = 4),
                 sep = "-"))
  )

Precip_Water_Year <- Precip %>% 
  group_by(Station, Water_Year) %>% 
  summarise(
    Land_Based_Precip = sum(Land_Based_Precip, na.rm = FALSE),
    ERA5_Precip = sum(ERA5_Precip, na.rm = FALSE),
    WaPOR_Precip = sum(WaPOR_Precip, na.rm = FALSE),
    PERSIANN_CDR_Precip = sum(PERSIANN_CDR_Precip, na.rm = FALSE),
    CHIRPS_Precip = sum(CHIRPS_Precip, na.rm = FALSE),
  )

summary(Precip_Water_Year)

Load geeID:


geeID <- read.csv(file = "dataset/Land_Based_Datasets/GIS/Land_Based_Stations.csv") %>% 
  select(Station, LAT, LONG, ELEV_SRTM3, ASPECT_SRTM3, SLOPE_SRTM3)
geeID
NA

Combine Precipitaion Data And geeID Data


data <- Precip_Water_Year %>% 
  left_join(y = geeID, by = "Station")


data
NA

Train & Test


ST <- c("ARAB HASAN - ASAD", "ALIGUDARZ")

Test <- data %>% filter(Station %in% ST)

Train <- data %>% filter(!(Station %in% ST))

Panel Data Model


pData <- pdata.frame(x = Train, index = c("Station", "Water_Year"))

Model_01 <- plm(
  formula = Land_Based_Precip ~ ERA5_Precip + ERA5_Land_Precip + PERSIANN_CDR_Precip
 + CHIRPS_Precip - 1,
 data = pData,
 effect = "twoways",
 model = "random",
 )

summary(Model_01)

LSDV Model of Panel Data Estimation


LSDV <- lm(formula = Land_Based_Precip ~ ERA5_Precip + ERA5_Land_Precip + PERSIANN_CDR_Precip + CHIRPS_Precip + ELEV_SRTM3 + ASPECT_SRTM3 + SLOPE_SRTM3 + LAT - 1,
           data = Train)

Coeff = data.frame(LSDV$coefficients)
colnames(Coeff) <- "Coeff" 

summary(LSDV)
lm(formula = Land_Based_Precip ~ ERA5_Precip + ERA5_Land_Precip + 
    PERSIANN_CDR_Precip + CHIRPS_Precip + ELEV_SRTM3 + ASPECT_SRTM3 +
